def count_sum(n):

def build(n):
    if n < 3: return bytearray()
    size = n // 2
    sieve = bytearray(b'\x01') * size
    sieve[0] = 0
    i = 1
    while True:
        p = 2*i + 1
        if p*p >= n: break
        if sieve[i]:
            start = 2*i*(i+1)
            sieve[start::p] = b'\x00' * (((size-1-start)//p)+1)
        i += 1
    return sieve

for _ in range(3):
    t=time.time(); s=build(5000000); a=1+sum(s); ts=time.time()-t
    t=time.time(); b=1+s.count(1); tc=time.time()-t
